summary: Backend-only test pass for Mission Velora (AI Life Architecture Platform). Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/ covering public endpoints, auth-gating, injected-session CRUD flows, and the AI blueprint generation. Injected a test user + session_token directly into MongoDB (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md) to exercise auth-gated routes. 32/32 tests passed on first run, including the Gemini 3 Pro blueprint call via emergentintegrations (returned _source='gemini-3.1-pro-preview').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 782 lines with all seed data + models + routes inline — consider splitting into modules (seed_data.py, models.py, routers/*) as it grows past 700 LOC threshold.
get_current_user reads Authorization via Header dependency but auth/logout re-reads via Header — minor duplication, not a bug.

In auth/session flow, the same Emergent endpoint is called via X-Session-ID for both raw session_id and already-issued session_token. This works today but couples two different token semantics into one path; add an inline comment noting this intentional reuse.
seed_data_creation: Inserted single test user (user_id=user_test0000001, email=TEST_velora_tester@velora.local) and session (session_token=test-token-velora-abc123, 7-day expiry) into MongoDB test_database.users / user_sessions. Cleaned up in session-scoped fixture teardown along with tasks/saves/onboarding/blueprints for that user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env), not EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Auth is Emergent Google OAuth — cannot automate the OAuth handshake; instead insert user + session_token straight into Mongo (see conftest.py `seeded_session_token` fixture). AI blueprint call ran successfully against gemini-3.1-pro-preview via emergentintegrations. If the Gemini call ever returns malformed JSON, the backend fallback path is exercised automatically — the test accepts either _source value. Frontend was intentionally not tested (Google OAuth cannot be automated; main agent screenshot-verified splash + auth screens).
